name: How long does it take to install shoe molding in a typical room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install shoe molding in a typical room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for shoe molding installation depends on the size of the room, the number of obstacles (like doorways or built-ins), and the chosen material. A standard rectangular room might take a few hours, while larger or more complex spaces could take a full day or longer. The process also includes time for cutting, fitting, and finishing (nailing, caulking, and painting if necessary). Understanding this process clarity helps manage expectations for project timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by room size, complexity, and material, typically a few hours for a standard room.
